name: MonarchAiErrorMessage
title: AiErrorMessage
wrapsNative: Text, MonarchButton, DisclosureGroup and ViewThatFits in a tinted RoundedRectangle
summary: The failure card for an assistant turn: what went wrong in plain words, the actions that can fix it, an optional retry countdown and a technical details disclosure.
whenToUse: In place of, or under, an assistant message whose turn failed.
whenNotToUse: Not for a status that is not a failed turn: use MonarchBanner. Not for a request that was blocked or adjusted for safety with guidance, which is AiSafetyNotice.
api: init(_ kind: MonarchAiErrorKind = .unknown, title: String? = nil, message: String? = nil, details: String? = nil, retryAfter: TimeInterval? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, announces: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels = MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onEditPrompt: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSwitchModel: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onNewConversation: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onSummarize: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
init(_ kind:, …the same parameters…, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)
enum MonarchAiErrorKind { case rateLimit, contextOverflow, safetyBlock, network, toolFailure, unknown }

MonarchAiErrorMessageLabels.init(tone: String? = nil, retry: String? = nil, retryIn: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, retryReady: String? = nil, editPrompt: String? = nil, switchModel: String? = nil, newConversation: String? = nil, summarize: String? = nil, details: String? = nil)

options.name: kind
options.description: Why the turn failed. MonarchAiErrorKind(code:) maps a raw error code.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title of the kind.

options.name: message
options.description: Replaces the built-in description of the kind.

options.name: details
options.description: Technical information, shown as selectable code behind a disclosure.

options.name: retryAfter
options.description: Seconds until a retry is allowed, counted from when the card appears.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows a progress indicator on the retry action.

options.name: announces
options.description: Announces the title and message when the card appears.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in tone name, action titles, countdown text and details title.

options.name: onSummarize
options.description: Shows "Summarize and continue", for contextOverflow only.

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra actions after the built-in ones.

states.name: kind
states.description: rateLimit, contextOverflow and safetyBlock use the warning tone; network, toolFailure and unknown the danger tone. Each kind has its own title, description, icon and action order.

states.name: counting down
states.description: The retry action is disabled and reads "Try again in 12s". Without onRetry the same text is shown as a caption.

states.name: retrying
states.description: The retry action shows a progress indicator and does not run.

states.name: details expanded
states.description: The technical details are shown in a bordered box.

appearance: The same surface as MonarchBanner: the subtle fill and the border of the tone, the strong role of the tone for the icon, default text for the title and muted text for the description. The first action is a primary button, the others secondary.
platformNotes: The parity map names MonarchBanner, but the banner takes one action and no custom icon or content, so the card is composed from the banner's tokens and the tone palette and looks the same. The web's code prop is MonarchAiErrorKind(code:). title and message are Strings, and details is a String shown as code. The many built-in strings are replaced through one labels value instead of one parameter each. The actions sit side by side where they fit and one under the other where they do not (ViewThatFits), instead of wrapping one by one. The countdown starts when the card appears and is checked every half second.
accessibility: The icon, title and message are one element, read as "Warning" or "Error", then the title, then the message.
Each action is a separate button with a 44-point touch target; the disclosure title is 44 points high.
The title and message are announced once, at high priority, when the card appears, unless announces is false.
"You can try again now." is announced when a countdown ends.
The tone is an icon and a spoken name as well as a colour. The raw error code is never shown or spoken.
While retrying, the retry button reads "Loading" as its value.
edgeCases: Without handlers and without extra actions there is no action row.
onSummarize is ignored unless the kind is contextOverflow.
A non-positive or infinite retryAfter is no countdown.
A code that matches several rules takes the first: rate limit, then context, safety, tool, network.
Long titles, messages and details wrap; details keep their line breaks.
